annotation.authors_or_issuer: UNESCO; Cambodia Ministry of Post and Telecommunications
named_instruments_referenced: UNESCO Recommendation on the Ethics of AI
annotation.summary_en: UNESCO web page announcing the Cambodia AI Readiness Assessment Methodology report, led by the Ministry of Post and Telecommunications and completed in July 2025. It identifies opportunities, challenges and recommendations to inform Cambodia's National AI Strategy, grounded in human rights, dignity and environmental well-being.
key_provisions_or_claims: RAM report completed July 2025 by Cambodia's Ministry of Post and Telecommunications with UNESCO
Identifies challenges and practical recommendations for ethical AI
Intended to inform development of a National AI Strategy
Full executive summary hosted on UNESCO Global AI Ethics and Governance Observatory
